name: Octo
description: Multi-LLM orchestration for Claude Code and Cowork. Coordinates 8 AI providers (Codex, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, OpenRouter, Copilot, Qwen, Ollama) through structured Double Diamond workflows with adversarial review and 75% consensus gates. 30+ specialized personas, 40+ slash commands, 50 + skills. Just say what you need — the smart router picks the right workflow.
longDescription:
Ships **63 skills**, **4 agents**, **51 commands**, **20 hooks** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (63): `flow-define` (Multi-AI requirements scoping using available external providers (Double Diamond Define phase)), `flow-deliver` (Multi-AI validation, scoring, and review using available external providers (Double Diamond Deliver phase)), `flow-develop` (Multi-AI implementation using available external providers (Double Diamond Develop phase)), `flow-discover` (Multi-AI research using available external providers (Double Diamond Discover phase) - Questions about best practices, patterns, or ecosystem…), `flow-parallel` (Decompose and execute large changes, migrations, or multi-issue fixes in parallel with quality gates), `flow-spec` (NLSpec authoring — use when you need a structured specification from multi-AI research and consensus), `octopus-architecture` (System architecture and API design with multi-AI consensus — use for design reviews and new subsystems), `octopus-quick` (Quick execution for ad-hoc tasks without full workflow overhead — use for small, self-contained requests), and 55 more
- **Agents** (4): `droids`, `personas`, `principles`, `skills`
- **Commands** (51): `auto` (Smart router - Single entry point with natural language intent detection), `brainstorm` (Start a creative thought partner brainstorming session), `careful` ([advanced] Activate destructive command warnings for the session), `claw` ([advanced] OpenClaw instance administration — manage hosts across macOS, Ubuntu/Debian, Docker, OCI, and Proxmox), `costs` ([advanced] Show cost breakdown by provider and workflow for the current session), `council` (Multi-LLM council for advice, decision support, implementation plans, and gated implementation), `debate` (AI Debate Hub - Structured debates across Claude and available external providers), `debug` (Systematic debugging with methodical problem investigation), and 43 more
- **Hooks** (20): `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `SessionStart`, `TeammateIdle`, `TaskCompleted`, `ConfigChange`, `WorktreeCreate`, `WorktreeRemove`, and 12 more
- **MCP servers** (1): `.mcp.json`

Installs with `claude plugin install octo@claude-community` from `nyldn/claude-octopus`.
